description: Create or change the user's monthly budget limit (one limit for all spending). Use when the user asks for a budget, or when you suggest one from their average monthly spending. This tool changes the user's Yomio data. Before you call it, tell the user exactly what will change and get their approval.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the limit, usually the user's default currency

name: set_monthly_budget
title: Set monthly budget
